translations.web: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
translations.bsb: So David shepherded them with integrity of heart and guided them with skillful hands.
translations.kjv: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
translations.asv: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them by the skilfulness of his hands. Psalm 79 A Psalm of Asaph.
